title: Voice Icons & Tags
desc: Identify and search voices with images and category tags.
lede: Icons and tags turn a pile of voices into a real, searchable library.
body:
In progress — the voice library (icons, tags, search) is part of the Phase 12 / 2.0 rollout.
At a glance
  • Upload a 1:1 icon per voice.
  • Tag voices (gender, age, accent, character, …).
  • Search and filter by tag.
  • Per-voice plugin settings.

Voice icons

Give each voice a square (1:1) icon. It shows on cards and pickers so voices are easy to recognize.

Tags

Tag voices by their qualities — class, gender, age, accent, tone, and free-form labels — so you can find the right one fast. The tag set is organized into simple sections.

Searching & filtering

Search and filter the library by tag. Rich, structured tags also power AI voice casting.

Coming with 2.0 — voices published to Hugging Face carry the same icon, sample, and tags, and are discoverable by the audiobook-studio-voice tag.
